blurb: Montgomery-Gibbs Executive Airport is a general aviation airport classified as a reliever for San Diego International Airport. It operates 24/7 with a control tower open daily from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. The airport offers services including fuel, parking, hangars, maintenance, flight training, aircraft rental and sales, charter, car rental, restaurants, and a hotel.
